task: accept an external truth source that is independent of the RGB cue detector
purpose: break the detector-proves-itself deadlock on localization and terminal, without inventing a source

required_declaration: source kind: B-1 app-side export | B-2 app source tree | B-3 controlled ground-truth capture
what it is: exact path, repository, or procedure
what it provides: which of F1 hero position / F2 match terminal / F3 structure state / F4 life-and-death
how it is obtained: the command or step
not_accepted_as_proof: a schema or sample that was assumed rather than shown

facts.F1: hero position in a fixed frame, per sampled instant, from game state not from the screen
facts.F2: match terminal win/loss/draw and the ending tick, decided by the game not inferred from pixels
facts.F4: alive state and the death or recovery moments

binding.refuses: any row whose fields the declared schema does not name
binding.writes: derived values only, never raw video, source paths, serials or device paths

duplication_guard: if the second position derivation agrees with the recorded signal exactly on most steps it is a duplicate of that signal, not an independent reference, and the audit must fail
what_it_would_settle: whether the cue-localized position is accurate, against an external frame
whether a recorded terminal was real or a timeout
whether the cold start is genuinely impassable rather than impassable to the three mechanisms tried
what_it_would_not_settle: whether the policy is good, on its own
a match-level win rate from one or few runs
full-match competence, which needs a scenario with departure, combat, death recovery and a terminal

implementation_gate.may_start_only_after: the owner's source declaration is recorded
implementation_gate.first_step: a read-only importer plus a paired check against the frozen cue
forbidden_before_that: defining a schema for a source that does not exist
